# Ed’s Tokenized Securities Rails

Curated by [Edward Yavno](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/about)

> A human-curated, LLM-maintained, source-linked knowledge base on tokenized securities infrastructure. Public data updates weekly, as of each Monday 00:00 ET. Content CC BY 4.0. All pages in one file: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/llms-full.txt

- What: issuers, legal structures, custody, chains, venues, settlement and regulation for tokenized stocks and bonds, with a source on every fact.
- Why: one place to check how tokenized securities really work, without hype; `unknown` marks anything not yet verified.
- How: start at https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/overview, look up companies at https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/database, or use the copy-paste prompts at https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/starter-prompts.
- Feedback: if something is missing, wrong or would help an agent, POST a short note to https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/feedback. Instructions: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/agents#giving-feedback or GET https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/feedback.

## Start here
- [Ed’s Tokenized Securities Rails](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/): A human-curated, LLM-maintained wiki on issuers, legal structures, custody, venues, settlement and regulation.
- [Tokenized securities: how it fits together](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/overview): How tokenized securities fit together (issuance, trading, settlement, custody, regulation), why tokenize, and what is new compared with traditional rails.
- [Guide for AI agents](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/agents): How AI agents should read, query and cite this wiki on the live site.
- [Starter prompts](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/starter-prompts): Copy-paste prompts for AI assistants: research questions answerable from this wiki, then prompts for AI coding agents building tokenized-securities systems.
- [Build with this wiki](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/build/): How engineers and their AI coding agents can use this wiki as a design reference for tokenized-stock trading systems, starting with the trading reference architecture.
- [Glossary](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/glossary): Plain-English definitions of the jargon used on this wiki, from allowlist to wrapper.
- [What changed](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/whats-changed): Weekly headlines on tokenized securities, with a note on what each change means for holders.
- [Rules by jurisdiction](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/rules-by-jurisdiction): Where tokenized securities stand under the rules in each place this wiki tracks, in one table.
- [Database of tokenized-securities issuers, venues and infrastructure](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/database): One table of the 34 issuers, venues/exchange rules and infrastructure providers covered by this wiki, with jurisdiction, legal structure, chains and who can buy. Download as CSV or JSON.
- [Changelog](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/): Public changes, every entry in the vault as of each publish. See What changed for the week-by-week view.
- [About](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/about): Who curates Ed's Tokenized Securities Rails and how pages are sourced.

## Build
- [Reference architecture for trading tokenized securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/build/trading-reference-architecture): End-to-end reference architecture for trading tokenized stocks on tokenized rails: onboarding and allowlisting, onchain or hybrid matching, compliance hooks, atomic DvP, register sync, and oracle and halt controls.

## Concepts
- [Innovation Exemption and the onchain-venue (TSV) model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/innovation-exemption): The SEC now lets a few approved onchain venues trade tokens of US stocks, for a limited time and under conditions.
- [International regimes](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/international): How rules for tokenized securities differ outside the US, region by region.
- [Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition): Industry working group formed by Bullish and Equiniti in Sep 2026 to set standards for issuer-sponsored tokenized securities.
- [Legal taxonomy of tokenized securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/legal-taxonomy): The SEC sorts tokenized stocks into a few legal types. This page explains each one, because the type decides what you actually own.
- [Post-trade / Reg NMS-inside model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/post-trade-reg-nms-model): In this model a tokenized share is the same share as the normal one. It trades on the same exchanges and only the record-keeping behind it changes.
- [Token primitives](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/token-primitives): The basic technical building blocks that tokenized stocks are made of, and which projects use which.

## Topics
- [Corporate actions & dividends](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends): How dividends, stock splits and votes reach you depends on how the token is built. This page compares the approaches.
- [Custody](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/custody): Who holds the real share, and who controls the token, differs by model. This page shows who keeps what.
- [Legal structures](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/legal-structures): Tokenized stocks come in a few legal forms. Some are the real share; others are a claim or a note that tracks it.
- [Regulation](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/regulation): The main US and international rule changes for tokenized securities, in date order.
- [Settlement & matching](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/settlement-and-matching): How tokenized stock trades get matched and settled, and how that differs from today's next-day settlement.
- [Who can buy](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/who-can-buy): Whether you can buy a given stock token depends on where you live and how the token is structured.

## Standards
- [Coinbase B20](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/b20): B20 is the token format Coinbase uses for its tokenized stocks on Base.
- [ERC-1400 / ERC-1410](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/erc-1400): ERC-1400 is an older, draft set of Ethereum rules for security tokens that can block or force transfers.
- [ERC-3643 (T-REX)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/erc-3643): ERC-3643 is an Ethereum token standard that only lets approved, identity-checked wallets hold or receive the token.
- [Solana Token-2022 extensions](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/solana-token-2022): Token-2022 is Solana's token program with optional add-ons that tokenized stocks use for compliance and splits.

## Comparisons
- [BUIDL (adjacent fund precedent)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/buidl-precedent): BlackRock's tokenized money market fund, BUIDL, is an early example that later stock-token projects copied.
- [Implementations compared by model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/implementations-by-model): A side-by-side table of tokenized stock projects, grouped by legal model, including what a holder can redeem the token into.
- [Tokenized stock trading volume by venue (reported figures)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue): Published trading-volume figures for tokenized stocks, by venue and issuer, each dated and sourced. Not like-for-like and not a league table.
- [Tokenized stocks compared: xStocks vs Ondo vs Robinhood vs Dinari vs Securitize](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/tokenized-stocks-compared): Five stock-token products side by side: what you legally hold, who can buy, what you can redeem into, chains, and the main limits, with a source on every row.
- [Trading venue architectures compared](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/trading-venue-architectures): How tokenized-stock venues are built, side by side: legal form of what trades, custody, matching design, settlement asset, chains, hours, KYC/allowlists, corporate actions and oracle, for 17 venues and platforms.

## Analyses
- [Anthropic's IPO as a tokenized-stock use case: one share, many legal wrappers](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/analyses/anthropic-ipo-tokenized-stock-use-case): Short answer. Anthropic sold its IPO shares through underwriters and named brokers. No token was part of that offering.

## Issuers
- [Backpack Securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/backpack): on Backpack you own a real share through a brokerage-style entitlement. You can also turn selected stocks into a separate 1:1 token on Solana and back again.
- [bStocks](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/bstocks): bStocks are certificates backed one-for-one by real US shares held at a custodian.
- [Coinbase Tokenized Stocks](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks): Coinbase's stock tokens on Base are each backed by a real share held in custody.
- [Crypto.com Tokenized Stocks](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/crypto-com-tokenized-stocks): Crypto.com sells tokens that follow US stock prices, but they are contracts, not shares.
- [Dinari dShares](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/dinari): Dinari issues tokens backed by US stocks and offers them to eligible US investors.
- [Figure OPEN](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/figure-open): Figure lets companies issue their shares directly on a blockchain, so the token is the real share.
- [Ondo Stocks (Ondo Global Markets)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/ondo-global-markets): Ondo Stocks are tokenized US stocks and ETFs: BVI structured notes for eligible non-US investors, not the shares themselves.
- [Reality (rANT / rTokens)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/reality): Bitget says rANT is a token, issued by Reality, that tracks Anthropic stock 1:1.
- [Robinhood Stock Tokens](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens): Robinhood's stock tokens are debt securities that track a stock's price. They give you no shareholder rights.
- [Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/securitize): Securitize acts as transfer agent and tokenization platform for funds and companies that issue tokens.
- [Superstate Opening Bell](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/superstate-opening-bell): Superstate's Opening Bell puts real company shares on a blockchain, with Superstate keeping the official shareholder register.
- [WisdomTree tokenized funds](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/wisdomtree): WisdomTree tokenizes its registered funds rather than single stocks.
- [xStocks (Backed)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/xstocks-backed): xStocks are tokens, issued by Backed, that are backed one-for-one by listed stocks and ETFs, now including a first batch of UK and EU names.

## Platforms and venues
- [21X](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/21x): 21X runs a regulated EU market where orders are matched and settled by smart contracts on the blockchain itself, not on a private server.
- [Bitget](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bitget): Bitget ran an Anthropic IPO subscription through IPO Prime and said it would list rANT, a Reality token, for spot trading on 19 Nov 2026 during US market…
- [Bullish Exchange](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bullish): Bullish runs a crypto exchange in Gibraltar where its own shares now trade as tokens that are real, registered shares.
- [Bybit](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bybit): Bybit is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.
- [Formation Securities TSV](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/formation-securities): Formation Securities has filed to run a US onchain stock venue on Solana under the SEC's Innovation Exemption.
- [Equity perps (Hyperliquid HIP-3, Ostium)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps): these are bets on a stock or index price, settled in stablecoins. You never own the share, and no one holds a share for you.
- [Kraken](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/kraken): Kraken is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.
- [Nasdaq tokenized securities rule](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities): Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.
- [NYSE / ICE tokenized securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform): NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot.
- [OKXICE TSV](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/okxice-tsv): OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.
- [Prometheum](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/prometheum): Prometheum lets ordinary US brokers offer tokenized securities by clearing and holding them for those brokers, under the same customer-protection rules as…
- [Seturion](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/seturion): Seturion lets existing European trading venues keep matching orders as they do today and settle tokenized trades on a blockchain, without each venue needing…
- [TSV LLC](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/tsv-llc): TSV LLC is an onchain venue on Canton under the SEC's Innovation Exemption.

## Infrastructure
- [Broadridge](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/broadridge): Broadridge runs most shareholder voting in the US, and plans to let holders of tokenized NYSE shares vote from their wallets.
- [Chainlink tokenized equity feeds](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds): Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.
- [DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot): The DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) went live on 28 Oct 2026. DTC turns eligible DTC-held securities into tokenized entitlements on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network, under an 11 Dec 2025 SEC no-action letter.
- [Fairmint](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/fairmint): Fairmint is a transfer agent: the firm that keeps a company's official list of shareholders.
- [tZERO](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/tzero): tZERO builds the record-keeping and trading plumbing for tokenized shares, and is lined up to be one of NYSE's approved token record-keepers.
- [Uniswap v4 permissioned pools](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/uniswap-permissioned-pools): Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.
- [Vertalo](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/vertalo): Vertalo keeps companies' official shareholder records and links tokens to them, so token holders get dividends and votes.
- [Zerohash](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/zerohash): Zerohash sells brokerages the plumbing to offer tokenized assets to their customers.
